name: elevate-navbar
title: Elevate Navbar
description: A responsive glassmorphism navbar with animated dropdowns, text-swap hover effects, and a collapsible mobile menu.

changelog.summary: Added prefers-reduced-motion support: dropdown and hover color transitions are set instantly instead of tweened when the user has reduced motion enabled

props.name: activeColor
props.description: Active and focused nav link color.

props.name: inactiveColor
props.description: Dimmed nav link color while another item is active.

props.name: duration
props.description: Nav, dropdown, and mobile accordion animation duration.

props.name: ease
props.description: GSAP easing used for nav and dropdown transitions.

props.name: staggerItems
props.description: Reveals dropdown items one by one.
